Android · Free · Coming soon

A free financial tracker that keeps your data on your phone.

Squirio is an Android app for tracking expenses, budgets, savings, and debts. It requires no account, subscription, advertising, or paid tier. Your records stay in one file on your device, and budget periods can begin on payday instead of the first day of the month.

Follow launch updatesExplore features

Free · AndroidComing October 2026

What Squirio does not do

  • No accountNothing to sign up for
  • No cloudNo automatic upload
  • No adsNo tracking, no analytics
  • CSV export and backupBackup + CSV, any time

Designed around real routines

A clearer way to track everyday money.

Squirio focuses on the three choices that most change the experience: when a budget begins, where records live, and how quickly a transaction can be entered.

01

Budgets based on payday, not the 1st.

If you are paid on the 25th, a calendar-month report separates that income from much of the spending it covers. Squirio can use a period from the 25th to the 24th, keeping one salary and its expenses together.

Read the build note
02

Local storage, with no Squirio account or server.

Squirio stores financial records on your phone instead of creating a remote account. No outside copy is created unless you choose to export or back up the data.

Read the build note
03

Log a transaction in three taps.

Favorite entries, merchant suggestions, and an amount keypad reduce repeated work without automating away your control.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions about Squirio

Does it connect to my bank?

No. Enter transactions manually or import a CSV supplied by your bank. Squirio has no server or bank-aggregation service.

What happens if I lose my phone?

If the phone holds the only copy, the data is lost with it. Create a zip backup regularly and store it somewhere you control.

Is Squirio completely free?

Yes. Squirio is completely free, with no download fee, subscription, in-app purchase, advertising, or paid premium tier.

Can I get my data out?

Yes. Create a full zip backup or export every transaction to CSV through Android's share sheet.
